x: Much of the interest in this event was lost owing to the absence of Vickers, Hall and Middleton. The most impressive of the Juniors was David Cocks who took the 440 (53.1) and 880 (2:02.2) in magnificently relaxed style.

The weather in no way affected the times and although John Webb won in 50.57 Trowbridge's latest find John Kirk caused quite a sensation with his second place in 51.06. Belgrave were without Middleton but Carl Lawton produced a personal best 56.13 to anchor us in second place 2 points ahead of Leicester.

Gilt edge Hart, Duquemin, Middleton, Major, Kerr and Martin continue as the backbone of our economy. Whilst high flyers Bent and Thresher continue to excite, Dull spots occurred with results from Hilton, C.

With his departure it has left a slight gap in the Belgrave team although with youngsters like Lawton and Middleton we should pull through. Our Australian visitor Dave De Bondi has returned to his country.
Without Callow, Lawton, Middleton and Coates it was left to Ingarfield to lead the team home backed up by Len Duquemin, John Dunsford and sprightly Dave McMullen.
To go to the head of the field and win the race and to be acclaimed with the names of Whitlock, Baker, Thompson, Pamich, Middleton is something extra.

George Williams, a wonderful stylist, former Belgrave walker and International was recently seen in Bournemouth and sent his regards to all his 60's compratriats; Messrs Middleton, Vickers, Hall, etc..,

"Our two Rays of sunshine, Hall and Middleton, have certainly turned on the heat this summer. Their second and third place in the National 50 Kilos at Luton behind Olympic gold medallist Don Thompson was great stuff and earned them well-deserved places in Britain's European Games team for Belgrade.

Mens 10 miles:- Hall (4th.79:08), King (20th.90:50), Ray Middleton (38th.100:58), Morris (40th.103:57). Ladies 5kms:- Spacey (1st.25:32), Brackpool (6th.27:57), Morrison (7th.29.20), Barker (8th.29:20), Catherine Mann (10th.29:59), Christou (15th.35:33).
